scripts.setup:rust: rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown && cargo install wasm-pack --version 0.15.0 --locked && cargo install cargo-watch --locked
scripts.dev: echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) [WASM] Initial build..." && npm run build:wasm && echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) [WASM] Initial build done" && echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) [DEV] Starting watchers..." && rspack build --config rspack.config.js --watch & (cd wasm-core && cargo watch --postpone -w src -s 'echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) [WASM] Compiling..." && wasm-pack build --target web && echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) [WASM] Build done"') & wait
scripts.dev:ts: echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) [DEV:TS] Starting watcher..." && rspack build --config rspack.config.js --watch
scripts.dev:rust: cd wasm-core && cargo watch -w src -s 'echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) [WASM] Compiling..." && wasm-pack build --target web && echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) [WASM] Build done"'
scripts.build:rspack: echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) [TS] Building Tempo datasource..." && node scripts/clean-plugin-dist.mjs && rspack build --config rspack.config.js --env production
scripts.build:webpack: echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) [TS] Building Tempo datasource with Webpack..." && node scripts/clean-plugin-dist.mjs && webpack --config webpack.config.js --env production
scripts.build:wasm: echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) [WASM] Building..." && cd wasm-core && wasm-pack build --target web && rm -f pkg/.gitignore && echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) [WASM] Build done"
scripts.test: npm run test:ts && npm run test:rust
scripts.lint: npm run lint:ts && npm run lint:rust
scripts.lint:ts: biome check src/ e2e/ tests/unit/tempo-dataframe-datasource.test.ts scripts/ playwright.config.ts
scripts.lint:rust: cargo clippy -p agent-core -- -D warnings && cargo fmt -p agent-core -- --check
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix:ts && npm run lint:fix:rust
scripts.lint:fix:ts: biome check --write --unsafe src/ e2e/ tests/unit/tempo-dataframe-datasource.test.ts scripts/ playwright.config.ts
scripts.lint:fix:rust: cargo fmt -p agent-core && cargo clippy -p agent-core --fix --allow-dirty -- -D warnings
scripts.format: npm run format:ts && npm run format:rust
scripts.format:ts: biome format --write src/ e2e/ tests/unit/tempo-dataframe-datasource.test.ts scripts/ playwright.config.ts
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check:ts && npm run format:check:rust
scripts.format:check:ts: biome format src/ e2e/ tests/unit/tempo-dataframe-datasource.test.ts scripts/ playwright.config.ts
scripts.package: echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) [PKG] Packaging..." && npm run build && VER=$(node -p "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('package.json', 'utf8')).version") && cd dist && zip -FSqr vaduga-mapgl-datasource-$VER.zip vaduga-mapgl-datasource && echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) [PKG] Done: vaduga-mapgl-datasource-$VER.zip"
scripts.dev:reload: echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) [RELOAD] Building and restarting Grafana..." && npm run build && docker compose up -d grafana --force-recreate && echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) [RELOAD] Done"
scripts.verify: echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) [VERIFY] Starting..." && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build:webpack && echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) [VERIFY] All checks passed"
